claims.subject: Compliance basis for the HAA5 MCL under subpart L
claims.value: Running annual arithmetic average (RAA), computed quarterly, of quarterly arithmetic averages of all samples collected by the system (system-wide), required until the date specified for subpart V compliance in 141.620(c)
conditions: The quoted 141.133(b)(1)(i) basis is for systems monitoring quarterly; systems monitoring less frequently than quarterly demonstrate compliance if the average of that year's samples does not exceed the MCL, and an exceedance moves them to quarterly monitoring per treatment plant (141.133(b)(1)(ii))

claims.value: Calculate the LRAA from monitoring results collected under subpart V and determine that each LRAA does not exceed the MCL; more than one sample in a quarter at a location is averaged into one quarterly value; if four consecutive quarters are not completed, compliance is based on the average of the available data from the most recent four quarters
